title: processkit fetch result data
description: The data member of the cli@v1 result envelope for processkit fetch (inheritance@v1 PK-INH-036, PK-INH-039). Failures are diagnostics; this object reports what was resolved and stored.

refs.description: One entry for every declared upstream, sorted by name.

commit.description: Commit the ref resolved to; null when resolution failed.

commits.description: Every commit the run needed, sorted by source, then commit; each source and commit pair at most once.

for.description: Lock entry names (current lock, or the entry names a first lock would use) that need this commit, sorted.

result.description: fetched: downloaded and verified in this run. present: already in the local cache and verified. failed: not stored; a diagnostic names the reason.
